# RH Mods — Asset Editor

- Language / date: English; publication date not displayed.

Originally developed for Desperados, this editor is described as also supporting Robin Hood RES files. The page lists previewing, exporting, and replacing interface images and text entries.

The description is brief and supplies no tested resource inventory or version matrix. It is a useful lead for interface and localization research, rather than a complete file-format reference.
